source_boundary: DMS root owns actual FS INIT, child role selection, per-node context creation, all policy transitions and retirement request.
Fixed assembly reads actual Linux AT_PAGESZ before changing its initial stack. It supports the already-selected 4096-byte x86-64 guard-page template and refuses any different actual page size.
stdin is a private USER-only raw frame transport for this component. It cannot inject a child, memory ACK or retirement ACK.

Higher Store still must supply admitted canonical DB paths and source-issued DB identity/descriptor authority. This component does not authenticate arbitrary user-supplied headers or replace the missing root/inode owner.

Gateway command16 provides real FS token operations while refusing access to internal SHM tokens and CLOSE of an attached DB token. It is a private typed predecessor interface, not a public Store API.

Every child capsule includes the exact originally issued immutable REQUEST, actual complete output/workspace, actual image-entry serial, node, create flag and stage. A memory primitive ACK is never substituted for REQUEST.
GROW reuses the same immutable source or completed child capsule; it never repeats a producer or syscall.
Memory actual extents are recorded by actual context and address, before copy/unmap. A failed unmap is quarantined and cannot be reused or borrowed.

After last Map PURGE and FS CLOSE, HIA emits an exact retirement event. The carrier checks actual live/quarantine mapping counts, releases the issued contexts once, and returns a monotonic actual retirement ACK.

A failed mechanical cleanup is fatal/UNKNOWN. Injected failed filesystem CLOSE is a real negative receipt and is not relabelled as a closed FD. The test explicitly observes the descriptor until process exit.
No global resource-count or byte quota is added to the production mapping or context registries. Test-only raw-response and /proc owned-child read bounds are fixtures, not language limits.
